about: Display replacement in chat (expert-catalogue spec §7.3), shared by frontend/src/catalogue/displayPlainNames.test.ts (displayPlainNames: the chat text and the browser speech path) and tests/test_display_plain_names.py (services/chat_plain_names.py display_plain_names: the live-voice TTS path). user is the message the text answers. Plain names are the Parameter catalogue's (modelNames.generated.json on the frontend, asset_schema lookup on the server).

cases.why: a backticked catalogue name is shown as its plain name
a name shared by classes with different plain names stays raw (p_nom: Capacity or Power)
a name the catalogue does not hold stays raw
cases.text: Tag the link `grid_import`, and read `p_nom_opt` after the run.
cases.want: Tag the link `grid_import`, and read `p_nom_opt` after the run.

cases.why: fenced code is left as written
cases.text:
Like this:
```python
n.stores.loc['h2', 'e_nom'] = 200  # `e_nom`
```
Then `e_nom` is set.
cases.want:
Like this:
```python
n.stores.loc['h2', 'e_nom'] = 200  # `e_nom`
```
Then Energy capacity is set.

cases.why: a tilde fence is code too

cases.text: The e_nom of the store and its marginal_cost stay.
cases.want: The e_nom of the store and its marginal_cost stay.

cases.why: quoted text (often the user's own words) is left as written, up to the blank line
cases.text:
> You asked about `e_nom`
and `s_nom`.

Here `e_nom` is 200 MWh.
cases.want:
> You asked about `e_nom`
and `s_nom`.

Here Energy capacity is 200 MWh.

cases.why: about the key: a name in the user's message stays raw in the reply, others are replaced
cases.text: `e_nom` is the store's size in MWh; a line's size is its `s_nom`.
cases.want: `e_nom` is the store's size in MWh; a line's size is its Rating.
Energy capacity, Rating, Demand and Running cost are set; `p_nom` is not.

cases.why: only single-backtick spans holding exactly one name
a component id that looks like snake_case is not a model name and stays raw
cases.text: Rename the generator `wind_farm` and the bus `grid_bus_1`.
cases.want: Rename the generator `wind_farm` and the bus `grid_bus_1`.
